integrity: Symbolic proof of all quantified statements; 22200 finite integer-arithmetic checks corroborate but do not imply them. The documents make no claim of independent scientific verification.
scientific_limitations: For arbitrary coprime reduced widths, the theorem determines only mixed areas below min(d,b); the complete spectrum is proved only at width ratio 3:5. Lattice polytopes may be segments. The previously known isolated pair (30,50) is not claimed as new. Historical priority has not been independently certified.
title: Low mixed-area rigidity and the complete \(3:5\) lattice-width spectrum
